What's drawing you to it, the Wingbits side or the Geodnet RTK side?

Then the MGW310 is the right unit. It's one weatherproof outdoor box that earns on both networks. On Wingbits it tracks aircraft up to 250 nautical miles out and earns points now, with $WINGS to come. On Geodnet it provides RTK and earns $GEOD. It connects over Ethernet or WiFi. It's sold as final sale, so make sure the spot works before you buy.

It has to be installed outdoors. Do you have a rooftop or mast spot with a clear view of the sky?
yup

Then you're set up for it. It's $1,095 USD. Shipping to Canada means no import VAT or duty, and any sales tax is added at checkout.
